articles.description: AFP journalist Christina Assi, who lost a leg in an Israeli strike reporting from the Lebanese border and has become a vocal campaigner for reporters' safety, was honored by the Committee to Protect Journalists on Thursday. In October 2023, Reuters journalist Issam Abdallah was killed and six others were wounded, including AFP journalists Assi and Dylan Collins, while covering the conflict near the Israeli border. An independent AFP investigation concluded that two Israeli 120mm tank shells were fired from the Jordeikh area in northern Israel.
